label: copy-phase input z re-fed as 3rd/4th original token in long (L>=8) sequences
explanation: Extremely sparse (0.03% of steps). Fires only in the copy phase, never on original or delimiter steps. About 79% of the activation mass is on steps where the input is z, which is being fed back as original token 2 or 3, so recall_idx is 3 or 4 (t = 10-13). It is mostly in L = 9 sequences (72% of mass), with some in L = 8. The rest of the mass is on s or c in the same positions (s about 10%, c about 6%). The strongest activations are z at recall_idx 3 in L = 9 or L = 8. Precision is low: most z inputs at these positions do not cross the threshold, and none of the variables I tested (later t, out_tok vowels, which other tokens are present) explains which ones do. It does not fire on z during the original phase, or on z in short sequences (L <= 6).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=z (+3.27), phase=2 & in_tok=s (+3.07), phase=2 & in_tok=c (+2.94), in_tok=z (+2.55), phase=2 & out_tok=i (+2.44), phase=2 & in_tok=o (+2.27). Lower it: orig6=- (-2.40), out_tok=q (-1.76), out_tok=u (-1.75), prev2_tok=w (-1.66).
